name: wanderpage
description: Turn a folder of travel photos on this Mac into a private, curated static trip page. Never identifies people, never publishes exact GPS, and runs a privacy scan before anything is published.

project.title: Wanderpage project folder
project.description: The folder `npx @buildproven/wanderpage` set up (~/wanderpage by default). It must contain mcp/server.ts. Drafts and the published site live here.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: Enables the full edit and strict people exclusion. Without it, Wanderpage ranks photos by technical quality only.
